description.value:
The hammer is a powerful blunt weapon with a surprising amount of mobility. It's also possible to stun monsters by delivering a hammer attack to the head.

Open Hammer in the Toolbox

Features

Mastery Property (Topple)

If you hit a creature, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

Power Charge

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you begin winding up the hammer. The weapon remains charged for 1 minute, until you hit with an attack using it, until you are knocked Prone or your are incapacitated. While charged, your walking speed increases by 5 feet, and your next successful attack with this weapon deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] bludgeoning damage.

▸ Upgrade — Charge Upgrade I

Your Power Charge now deals an extra [[/r 2d6]] bludgeoning damage on a hit.

Mighty Weapon

When you hit a creature that is Large or smaller with this weapon, you can choose to have it make a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency + your Strength modifier. On a failed save the creature is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once used, you can't use this property again until you finish a short or long rest.

Upswing / Spinning Bludgeon

Your charged attacks gain tactical versatility. When you hit a creature with an attack empowered by your Power Charge, you can choose one of the following additional effects:

Upswing: The target is pushed 10 feet away from you. If they hit a solid object (like a wall or another creature), they take an additional [[/r 1d6]] bludgeoning damage.

Spinning Bludgeon: You carry the momentum into a spin. Choose a second creature within 5 feet of the original target; you can immediately make one melee weapon attack against the second creature (this second attack does not benefit from the charge's extra damage).
